allowed_conclusions.claim: Within the published R9 bounded search, none of the 12 S4/S5 top-five lists, final beam snapshots, selected winners, or native top-five candidates contains a direct fusion action or fission action. Harris producer-consumer co-tiling is present and is a distinct paired-tiling rewrite.

S5 source census exposes 87 legal fission cuts in aggregate: LU 1, Harris 30, Raytracing 56; LLaMA, Radar, and GCN have zero under the source-owned fission legality rules. The census is not evidence that those actions were attempted or scored.

The common 4096 unique-candidate limit was reached in 10 of 12 stages, making search-budget crowding plausible. Family-specific attempted/materialized/scored/archive counts are unknown, so the omission cannot be causally assigned to budget crowding. The recorded best measured cycles are equal S4/S5 for all six workloads.

source_line_references.finding: Maps full-joint to internal stage 5 and full-joint-fission to stage 6.
Fusion and sibling-fusion action families are generated only at stage >=5; paired producer-consumer co-tiling is a distinct two-tile action.
Fission is gated at stage >=6 and uses the authenticated prepared source to enumerate the complete legal source cut set.
Typed history records canonical shapes, ordinary actions, and fissionActions separately.
The per-round score quota is global over remaining candidate budget and rounds.
Pending neighbors are deterministically grouped/interleaved by action family; scored-family balancing is adaptive, not a fixed family quota.
Fission neighbors are removed when history is unknown, when ordinary action history is nonempty, when the path has multiple primitives, or when that task was already fissioned.
Seed manifest, previous winner, round, candidate, beam/diversity, source, worker, and fission cap options.
Beam has width/diversity slots; diversity selects path/configuration variants only for expansion.
Final shortlist is the first five records under one global archive sort.
The search header records budgets, control inclusion, shortlist size, and S6 fission census/support metadata.
